identity.title: Boost-order facts and the exact rapidity round-trip

claims: Omega_tilt ~ (1+w) Omega_m sinh^2(beta): sinh^2(beta) has leading beta-order 2
the observer-boost kinematic quadrupole has leading beta-order 2
Omega_tilt^2 ~ (sinh^2 beta)^2 = sinh^4(beta) has leading beta-order 4
4 != 2, so an O(beta^4) Omega_tilt^2 term cannot cancel the O(beta^2) quadrupole (forbidden subtraction)
the order-correct deprojection subtracts an O(beta^2) term
rapidity round-trip: beta + (-beta) = 0 exactly (a boost and its inverse compose to the identity)

notes: Symbolic engines (Wolfram+xAct, SymPy, Sage+Singular) confirm the sinh^2/sinh^4 series orders; Lean and Rocq (kernel-independent) confirm the order arithmetic 2+2=4, 4!=2 and the exact rapidity round-trip. No majority vote; all five axes PASS.
